It can be used to attack directly or can reportedly be thrown like a boomerang.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 14 |durability = 17 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizal Boomerang}} Lizal Boomerangs are [[Weapon]]s favored by [[Lizalfos]] that can be used for either melee or thrown attacks. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by Lizalfos.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Though they are most commonly used by regular Lizalfos, [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] can also use these Weapons early on. When thrown, [[Link]] must catch the [[Boomerang]] before it returns to him, or else he will take damage. They can be found around [[Lake Hylia]] and in the [[Lanayru Wetlands]]. As metal Weapons, Lizal Boomerangs will spark and attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they are capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. They will sink when dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], however, they can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]].
